## Self-generated finite question

In Heartbeat World's full native six-dimensional spatial Cell torsor, can the joint exact squared-distance readings from all six positive primitive neighbors of a chosen Cell anchor identify every Cell in the full raw one-coordinate box? If not, classify every ambiguity in that entire box and exhibit an exact additional native reading that repairs it.

The route-independent motivation is spatial identity versus a finite jointly retained native-distance observation. Six native axes and six positive reference neighbors do not by themselves establish that the six readings preserve Cell identity. This question uses the fixed X6 substrate itself. It does not begin in an external lower-dimensional space or import a physical force/dynamics law.

## Actual whole, inputs and semantic types

Choose a native Cell anchor a and a signed raw chart over Z^6. Let e_i denote the six positive primitive native unit steps. Native spatial Cell identity is the full z in Z^6. The finite whole is

  B = {a+z : z in {-1,0,1}^6}.

All 3^6=729 Cells remain in the declared population. No sign, zero, parity, compositeness or norm class is omitted. B is a raw-chart finite restriction inside X6; it is not a final public Cell address set, an independent spatial world or a native plane. Every multi-axis displacement is realized as a composite native path, not a primitive diagonal direction.

The six reference Cells are p_i=a+e_i (1<=i<=6). The joint observer, with all six axis associations retained, is

  O(z)_i = d6(a+z,p_i)^2 = Q(z)+1-2z_i,
  Q(z) = sum_{i=1}^6 z_i^2.

The observer is an integer tuple. Q is the current native component quadratic reading already fixed by P000. No Euclidean-angle/continuum interpretation, physical propagation, branch-mass identification or force-balance law is assumed. This is a static spatial question; no time coordinate is required. The record adds neither a spatial axis nor a temporal dynamics claim. No compression is asserted safe before proving its fibers.

## Frozen statement

For z,w in {-1,0,1}^6, O(z)=O(w) holds exactly in either of the following cases:

1. z=w.
2. For a unique two-element subset A of {1,...,6}, the unordered pair {z,w} is {u_A,v_A}, where

   (u_A)_i=-1 for i in A and 0 otherwise;
   (v_A)_i=0 for i in A and 1 otherwise.

Consequently there are exactly 15 disjoint doubleton fibers, covering 30 Cells, and 699 singleton fibers. The six-reading observer has exactly 714 images on B. In every doubleton, Q(u_A)=2 and Q(v_A)=4. The augmented observer (O,Q), equivalently the six neighbor readings plus the squared distance to the anchor a, is injective on B.

The result is a derived finite native spatial/readout theorem and an exact no-go for six-positive-neighbor identity recovery on this declared whole. It is not proposed as a replacement for P000 or as a new axiom.

## Hand proof: necessity and all boundaries

Assume O(z)=O(w). For each i,

  Q(w)-Q(z)=2(w_i-z_i).

Thus the six signed integer differences agree: w=z+t*1 for one integer t, where 1=(1,1,1,1,1,1), and Q(w)-Q(z)=2t. Writing s=sum_i z_i and expanding the native quadratic reading gives

  2ts+6t^2=2t,
  t(s+3t-1)=0.

If t=0 then z=w. Otherwise interchange z,w if necessary so t>0. Since both coordinates lie in {-1,0,1}, t is either 1 or 2. If t=2 then every z_i=-1, so s=-6; the required equation s+3t=1 becomes 0=1, impossible. If t=1 then every z_i is -1 or 0, and s+3=1 gives s=-2. Exactly two coordinates are -1, all four others are 0. Their indices form A. Then w has 0 on A and 1 elsewhere, as stated. These possibilities exhaust every coordinate, including zero and all boundary signs, in the full finite whole.

## Hand proof: sufficiency, disjointness, exact count and repair

For any two-element A, Q(u_A)=2 and Q(v_A)=4. For i in A both readings equal 5: 2+1-2*(-1)=5 and 4+1-2*0=5. For i outside A both equal 3: 2+1-2*0=3 and 4+1-2*1=3. Hence O(u_A)=O(v_A).

Distinct A give distinct joint reading tuples, because exactly the coordinates indexed by A equal 5. The negative/zero members and zero/positive members are disjoint, so these are 15 disjoint pairs. Choosing the unordered two-element A gives 6*5/2=15. The whole has 3^6=729 Cells; subtracting 30 leaves 699 singletons, and 699+15=714 distinct readings. No software census or numerical probe supplies this count.

Finally every nontrivial fiber consists of a Q=2 Cell and a Q=4 Cell, so Q separates it. The preceding exhaustive fiber theorem proves (O,Q) injective for all of B. This is an exact observer-specific repair certificate, not a claim that O alone is safe or that Q is complete packet state.

## Covariance, allowed use and limits

Translating a and all reference Cells together preserves the statement, so a is a chosen Cell anchor rather than a global ontic origin. Permuting the six native axes permutes coordinates/readings and maps A to the corresponding two-element subset. The classification therefore respects the current S6 axis-permutation skeleton. The finite whole retains all six coordinates throughout.

The certificate covers this static full-box observer only. It does not identify full decorated packet states, erase path provenance needed by future path operations, assert safety for other observations or arbitrary dynamics, turn observer fibers into physical branch erasure, or claim a seven-sensor minimum over arbitrary sensor designs. It is not an automatic full-world tomography or rotation-dynamics theorem.

## Immediate consequences and explicit falsifiers

A positive answer to six-neighbor spatial identity recovery on B is falsified by any one pair, for example u_{1,2}=(-1,-1,0,0,0,0) and v_{1,2}=(0,0,1,1,1,1), whose exact joint readings are (5,5,3,3,3,3). These are internal signed raw proof coordinates, not public Cell addresses.

The frozen classification would be falsified by a pair z,w in B with equal O outside the listed 15 pairs, a listed pair with unequal O, a tripleton fiber, or a listed pair with equal anchor-distance Q. The algebra above rules these out under the declared native Q and B definitions.

## Methods and prior contribution declarations

No scientific program, enumeration, numerical probe, external search, downstream theorem/tool catalog or project scientific tool was used. Administrative JSON IO, hashes and original identity/activity/runtime helpers were used solely for provenance and registration. Prior contribution IDs in this execution: none.
